content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `FileContext` class not dynamically updating its umask setting when the configuration changed. Instead of using the current umask value obtained from the configuration (`FsPermission.getUMask(conf)`), the class was storing a static umask value in the constructor, which would not reflect changes made in the configuration after the instance creation. As a result, operations that rely on the umask to set file permissions would not respect updates to the umask configuration, leading to incorrect behavior. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the umask is retrieved from the configuration whenever it is needed, allowing it to reflect any changes made during the runtime.
